tool_input.command:
cd /workspaces/semio && python3 -c "
import json
with open('semio/assets/semio/nakagin-capsule-tower.shallow.design.semio.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)

# Build piece name -> guid mapping
piece_map = {p['name']: p['guid'] for p in d['pieces']}

# c1 is the larger tower (11 tambours, f0-f10)
# c0 is the smaller tower (9 tambours, f0-f8)

# Task 1: Remove the last storey (tambour + capsules) from the larger tower (c1)
# The last storey is floor 10 (t_f10_b_c1 and its capsules)
print('=== LAST STOREY OF C1 (to remove) ===')
last_storey_pieces = [n for n in piece_map if 'f10_b_c1' in n]
for n in sorted(last_storey_pieces):
    print(f'  {n}: {piece_map[n]}')

# Also need to find the capital
print()
print('=== CAPITAL C1 ===')
print(f'  ci_t_f10_b_c1: {piece_map[\"ci_t_f10_b_c1\"]}')

# The capital sits on tambour f10  
# Need to reconnect capital to tambour below (f9)
print()
print('=== TAMBOUR F9 C1 ===')
print(f'  t_f9_b_c1: {piece_map[\"t_f9_b_c1\"]}')

# Find connections involving f10 pieces
print()
print('=== CONNECTIONS INVOLVING f10_b_c1 ===')
for c in d['connections']:
    connected_piece = c.get('connected', {}).get('piece', {}).get('guid', '')
    connecting_piece = c.get('connecting', {}).get('piece', {}).get('guid', '')
    
    f10_guids = [piece_map[n] for n in last_storey_pieces]
    capital_guid = piece_map['ci_t_f10_b_c1']
    
    # Find name for guids
    guid_to_name = {v:k for k,v in piece_map.items()}
    
    if connected_piece in f10_guids or connecting_piece in f10_guids or connected_piece == capital_guid or connecting_piece == capital_guid:
        cn = guid_to_name.get(connected_piece, '?')
        gn = guid_to_name.get(connecting_piece, '?')
        print(f'  {cn} -> {gn} | guid={c[\"guid\"]}')
"
